diagnoses.description: The provided “above-minimum” startup-capability linearization can fail to enforce a stated startup_limit when startup_limit < Pmin. The constraint is written on (p_above_min + reserve) and does not include the Pmin*u term, so it can allow actual output = Pmin during a startup period even if that exceeds startup_limit (i.e., it does not correctly encode a limit on total MW during startup in the above-minimum variable convention).

locations.section: Reserve Deliverability (startup_limit and the “startup_reduction” above-minimum pattern)
